purpose: Define the exact data contract used to build each NFL team's What to Hunt page from verified sources without leaking unsafe or future-year records.

teamPageContract.priorityTargets: Take up to four players from team-targets.csv in listed order.
teamPageContract.referenceCard: Take exactly one team-matched reference from 2024-football-reference-map.csv only after the image has been localized and visually QA'd.
teamPageContract.exactHits: Aggregate only verified chase records whose team matches the selected team.
teamPageContract.masterChecklist: Group verified team-matched card rows by product. Products with partial data must be labeled coverage=partial rather than implying completeness.
teamPageContract.completion: owned verified rows / total verified rows currently exposed; UI must label partial product coverage where applicable.

sourceOrder: reference-card map after local image QA
hardFilters: team must match selected NFL team
XRC rows #501-520 are excluded from 2024 Team Hunt
Select rookie=true is ignored unless validated against trusted 2024 rookie registry or verified checklist
do not expose a reference image until the local asset exists and passes visual QA

sortOrder.withinProduct: card number ascending unless a verified chase priority overrides display order

coverageLabels.complete: CardStorm has verified and normalized the full intended team-visible scope for that product.
coverageLabels.partial: Only verified portions are exposed; UI must not claim full set completeness.
coverageLabels.blocked: Known unsafe/unverified data exists and must not render.
coverageLabels.upcoming: Not applicable to completed 2024 football products, reserved for future seasons.

navigationRequirements: Browser Back returns to prior team-selection state.
In-app Back uses history when available rather than routing directly Home.
Selected sport/year/team and scroll position should be restored when returning from a full product checklist.
mobileRequirements: minimum comfortable tap targets for owned checkboxes
reference card remains fully visible without forcing an oversized hero
productionGate: Do not wire this aggregation into the public Team Hunt route until launch-audit.csv has no blocking OPEN/PARTIAL items related to data safety, images, navigation or mobile QA.
